params.body:
Found while tracing a question from Ilse about Hexon. Deliveries per receiver over seven days on production:

```
webhook 1 (yourdailydrive)       577 deliveries, 577 succeeded
webhook 2 (Hexon)                650 deliveries, 525 succeeded
webhook 3 (FlexLease)          1.933 deliveries,   0 succeeded
webhook 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10        249 deliveries,   0 succeeded   <- deleted on 23-03-2026
```

Eight receivers carry `deleted_at = 2026-03-23 15:35:51` and were still being called every day, half a year later, every call failing.

## A column that said the opposite of what it meant

`webhooks.deleted_at` was `datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp()`, with the zero date standing for "not deleted". Those are two traps pointing in opposite directions. `SoftDeletes` checks `IS NULL` and would have hidden every receiver at once, including the three that must work. Filtering on "has a date" fails the other way, because that default stamps a **new** receiver as deleted the moment it is written. So nobody filtered, which worked fine until somebody deleted something.

This was already written down as open point O-24 on 11 September, with a test that would fail the moment the trait was added. That test earned its keep today: my first attempt was a global scope on "has a date", and it pointed straight at a fresh receiver becoming invisible.

## Fixed at the root

The migration makes the column nullable with `null` as the default and converts the zero dates, in `webhooks` and in `webhook_fields`, which carries the same column. `Webhook` then uses `SoftDeletes` and all four readers follow one rule: the repository that picks receivers, the job that fetches one, the Koppelingen panel and the Elixir probe. `WebhookField` does not get the trait, so nothing changes there; its column simply stops lying.

The old tripwire test now holds the other side: a fresh receiver carries no deletion date, and the trait is present.

## Not fixed, because it is a conversation and not code

FlexLease receives 1.933 deliveries in seven days on `backend.flexlease.rent/api/v1/stocklistdealer/webhook` and answers 404 to every one of them.

## Verified

Full suite: 2.140 tests, with only the two known `ListPageHeadersTest` cases failing, which fail the same way without this change because those tables are empty in my local database. `phpstan` green over the whole project; `pint` green. Migration ran locally.

Rule R S2-10.13. Fixes bevinding een-verwijderde-ontvanger-werd-nog-gebeld, closes open point O-24.
params.title: A deleted receiver is not called again
